# StructureIntegrity

Examining an anchored structure that can be destroyed (walls, windows, doors, machines, ...) shows its remaining
integrity, such as `Integrity: 490/500`, coloured green, yellow or red as it drops. The maximum is the damage at
which the structure breaks or is destroyed. Mobs and loose items are left out.

Entry point: `StructureIntegritySystem` (examine line, `TryGetIntegrity`).
